svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Molt architecture
svg.desc: Capture on the engineer machine redacts and signs Events and posts them to a Collector Lambda, which appends them to a CockroachDB Cloud cluster in one serializable transaction. Ingest and recall components, an erasure engine running under a fenced lease, and the evidence components all read and write the same cluster, which holds six memory tiers. A policy watcher on Fargate consumes the write stream as a changefeed. Certificates are signed with a KMS key and stored in S3 under Object Lock, and an untrusted auditor reads client filtered views through the cluster's managed MCP endpoint.
svg.text: Durable, governable memory for AI coding agents
A CockroachDB Cloud cluster is the only system of record. AWS supplies compute, key material, evidence storage, and telemetry. Model access is an interface.
Holds no database credential. Every branch exits with status 0.
Payload to Events. Client resolved from the workspace mapping.
Relays JSON RPC in both directions, byte for byte.
Instruments in house Python agents directly.
Secrets to a fixed token before the batch leaves the process.
Lambda function behind an HTTPS function URL.
Bearer token compared in constant time, then a
keyed signature over the timestamp and body.
5 MiB body bound. Reserved concurrency of 10,
so a leaked token has a bounded cost.
SERIALIZABLE. Well formed records persist even
when the batch also carries a malformed one.
database reachability, and no memory content.
Server side, each holding a role scoped connection.
Opens an attribution version at ingest and supersedes
the previous one. A stored claim is never edited.
Batches, unit normalises, and drains pending rows in a
second transaction, so no provider call blocks ingest.
Index served nearest neighbour search with the tenancy
filter applied inside SQL, on the agent's critical path.
Retrievals and outcomes move procedure confidence.
Below the recall floor a procedure stops being served.
The only internet reachable memory content path.
Demonstration mode establishes a read only principal.
Every mutation route answers 403 by route name.
Any editor or agent that speaks the protocol.
Calls read only memory tools over stdio or HTTP.
Agent Skills shipped in the repository
verify certificate · residue sweep · retention audit
No idle server sits in front of any of it.
Signed cookie sessions, CSRF on mutations,
Public subnets. Security groups declare zero inbound rules.
Holds client sessions over both transports. Permitted
client set comes from configuration, never an argument.
Holds a changefeed cursor. Evaluates rules and owns
the kill switch and the approval queue.
Everything below runs from one argument tree.
erase residue sensitivity contend attest verify
recall watch serve mcp seed migrate
Exit codes separate operational, usage, and verification failure.
Creates the cluster, one service account per role, and the
auditor's filtered views. Applies both migration generations.
Probes the platform and records what it found.
Vector index present, with its reported operator class.
Garbage collection horizon measured at 4500 seconds.
On demand backup absent from the cloud control plane.
Three phases, all under one fenced lease.
One current lease per client, monotonic generation.
BACKUP INTO first. Managed reference as fallback.
Set based SQL. Sessions, events, artifacts, lineage.
Vector search. The borderline band fails closed.
Hard delete, or a rewrite validated before acceptance.
Threshold grid under the reader role. No writes.
Assembled by reading stored evidence rows back,
Verifies locally against the retrieved public key and
runs the embedded SQL under the reader role.
Root digest over every session chain tip in a window.
Disagreement is partitioned into accounted and not.
Configures and reports expiry that the cluster
TLS required. Six memory tiers, one mutability contract each.
All schema, transactions, and queries. Fifteen migrations.
Append only. No role holds UPDATE.
Only validity end and successor are ever written.
Revisable, always beside a change record.
Write once, apart from the lease itself.
Disposable. Physically deleted by Row Level TTL.
SERIALIZABLE isolation. Sequence numbers and chain digests
are computed inside the inserting statement.
VECTOR(1024) behind a distributed vector index, L2 operator
class, so every vector is unit normalised at write time.
Changefeeds carry the write stream to the watcher.
Recursive CTEs close the lineage graph, with a cycle guard.
AS OF SYSTEM TIME corroborates counts inside the horizon.
Four roles, column scoped grants, ON DELETE RESTRICT on
audit evidence. BACKUP INTO before the first mutation.
Client filtered views, granted select only, reached with an
expiring service account. Queries are logged.
Every read is scoped by client identifier inside SQL,
so tenancy is a query property rather than a convention.
Explicitly not trusted, which is why access is read only.
Connects an editor to the managed endpoint and runs the
certificate's own verification SQL against live data.
Called by the Embedder, the Adjudicator, and the Rewriter.
Refuses at startup any embedding implementation whose
reported width is not 1024, before a vector is written.
Documented default implementation for both roles.
Prompt caching. One stable prefix is reused across an
adjudication batch, marked above a measured floor.
Each one holds an obligation the code cannot hold alone.
One asymmetric key signs certificates and checkpoints.
The sign permission sits on exactly one role.
Versioning and Object Lock enabled at bucket creation.
A bucket policy denies unencrypted writes.
A connection string per role, the ingest token, the
Metrics under a cardinality bound, overflow to logs.
Ten templates. Least privilege. No inbound rules.
sign, then store under Object Lock
Three bands, each feeding the one cluster on the right.
Band one is capture and ingest. Events are redacted and
signed on the machine, verified at the Collector, and
appended in one transaction whose own statement computes
the sequence number and the chain digest.
Band two is read and govern. Recall answers the agent
before it acts, client agents reach read only tools, and the
watcher consumes the write stream so a rule can halt a
session rather than annotate it afterwards.
Band three is erase and prove. One fenced lease, a backup
before the first mutation, three phases, and a certificate
A dashed edge is a path retained as a fallback.
